findings.finding: Skill structure pattern - YAML frontmatter with name and description required
findings.evidence:
---
name: skill-creator
description: Guide for creating effective skills...

findings.finding: Skills have three loading levels: metadata (always), SKILL.md body (when triggered), resources (as needed)
findings.evidence:
1. Metadata (name + description) - Always in context (~100 words)
2. SKILL.md body - When skill triggers (<5k words)
3. Bundled resources - As needed

findings.finding: Frontend-architect is the primary consumer requiring ASCII mockups
findings.evidence: ASCII Mockup Template showing BEFORE/AFTER states with box-drawing characters

findings.finding: ASCII mockup pattern uses +---+ for borders and | for vertical lines
Advanced ASCII uses Unicode box-drawing characters for precise layouts
findings.evidence: Uses characters like: '|' for vertical, '-' for horizontal, '+' for corners

findings.finding: JUCE Component hierarchy is documented as tree structures
User flow diagrams use numbered steps with arrows

findings.finding: Skills should use imperative form in writing
Keep SKILL.md under 500 lines to minimize context bloat
findings.evidence: Keep SKILL.md body to the essentials and under 500 lines to minimize context bloat.
